content.title: Are Kroger Stores Open on Easter? What to Know for 2026
content.text: Kroger Easter Hours 2026: Will Stores Be Open This Year?Find out if the grocery chain will be welcoming customers on Sunday, April 5, plus holiday hours. April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTWill Kroger grocery stores be open this Easter? What to know for Sunday, April 5, 2026.Bloomberg / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster falls on Sunday, April 5, this year. Whatever you've got on the calendar to mark the Christian holiday, whether it's going out for Easter brunch with loved ones or hosting dinner at home, you may be in need of a few essentials to ensure the April holiday goes off without a hitch. If you're planning a trip to the grocery store this Sunday, you may be wondering if Kroger will be open on Easter in 2026.Given that many retailers, restaurants and businesses are closed in observance of the Easter holiday, as well as some major grocery chains, including Target, Costco and Publix, it's a fair question.For the most up-to-date information on Kroger Easter hours, TODAY.com reached out directly to the grocer for the latest on whether or not store locations will be open on Sunday, April 5, along with open and close times. See below to learn Kroger's hours, as well as other stores that fall under the Kroger brand, including Baker’s, City Market, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Foods Co, Fred Meyer, Fry’s, Gerbes, Metro Market, Pick ‘n Save, QFC, Ralphs, Smith’s Food and Drug, and others. Whatever you've got planned for Easter, here's what to know about Kroger stores this weekend.According to a Kroger spokesperson, a majority of Kroger grocery stores will be open during regular business hours on Easter Sunday.Standard store hours are typically 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. or 7 a.m. to 11 p.m., but hours may vary by location. Because of that, it's a good idea to confirm local open and close times ahead of visiting your nearest Kroger on Easter.For specific store details, check the Kroger store locator right here.
